sections.heading: HONOURS SPECIALIZATION IN FRENCH STUDIES (Brescia) - ADMISSION DISCONTINUED
lines: Faculty of Arts and Humanities - French Studies

Admission to this module is discontinued, effective September 1, 2025. Students currently enrolled in the module will be permitted to graduate upon fulfillment of the module requirements by August 31, 2028.

Completion of first-year requirements with no failures. Students must have an average of at least 70% in 3.0 principal courses, including French 1900E or French 1910 (or permission of the Department) plus 2.0 additional courses, with no mark in these principal courses below 60%.
2.0 courses: French 2600E (or French 2605F/G and French 2606F/G), French 2900 (or French 2905A/B and French 2906A/B).
1.0 course: French 3900 (or 1.0 of French 3905A/B, French 3906A/B, French 3907A/B, French 3908A/B).
1.5 courses from: French 3560F/G, French 3570F/G, French 3602F/G, French 3692F/G, French 3760F/G, French 3890A/B.
1.0 course from: French 4900A/B, French 4901A/B, French 4903A/B, French 4908A/B
2.5 additional courses in French at the 3000-level or above.
Note: French 2600E (or French 2605F/G and French 2606F/G) is prerequisite for further studies in French Literature.
Prior to May 1, 2024, this module was offered by Brescia University College.
